event.title: Independent Autopsy of Nolan Wells Reveals Undetermined Cause of Death
event.canonical_title: Independent Autopsy of Nolan Wells Reveals Undetermined Cause of Death
event.summary: An independent autopsy conducted on 18-year-old Nolan Wells, who was found dead off Horn Island in Mississippi, has concluded that the cause and manner of death are 'undetermined' pending further investigation. The findings were announced by the legal team representing Wells' family, indicating that the investigation into the circumstances surrounding his death is ongoing.

timeline.title: Independent Autopsy of Nolan Wells Reveals Undetermined Cause of Death
timeline.summary: An independent autopsy conducted on Nolan Wells has concluded that the cause and manner of his death are 'undetermined.' The doctor who performed the autopsy noted that foul play could not be ruled out, raising further questions about the circumstances surrounding the Mississippi teen's death.
key_facts: Independent autopsy found cause of death undetermined
